summary.text: Pinny Beebe-Center is a Democratic member of the Maine Senate for Senate District 12, which covers Appleton, Camden, Cushing, Friendship, Hope, Rockland, Rockport, Thomaston, Union, Vinalhaven, Warren and other communities in Knox County.
The Senate page lists Pinny Beebe-Center as chair of the Criminal Justice and Public Safety committee.

paragraphs.text: The page lists Senate service in the 131st and 132nd Legislatures and prior service in the House in the 127th through 129th Legislatures.
Committee assignments listed: Criminal Justice and Public Safety (chair); State and Local Government.
